outfit.prose: intimate and cozy morning loungewear: an oversized crisp white men's button-up collared dress shirt borrowed from Yuuji draped loosely over her petite frame, sleeves rolled up in messy folds, wide open collar revealing delicate collarbones and shoulders, hemline reaching mid-thigh, bare legs, and bare feet
